entrypoints.frame.luau:
--!strict
--!optimize 2
-- Run the unchanged synthetic frame for one build, preserving its exact returned medians.
-- Usage: luau -O2 [--codegen] tmp/perf/doc110/frame.luau -a jecs|previous|lib
local run = require("../../../bench/frame_scene")
local select_build = require("./select_build")
local ecs, label = select_build(({ ... })[1])
local report = run({ { label, ecs } })
for _, mode in { "inline", "cached" } do
    print(string.format("FRAME\t%s\t%.17g\t%.17g", mode, report[mode][label][1], report[mode][label][2]))
end
entrypoints.leak.luau:
--!strict
--!optimize 2
-- Isolated copy of bench/leak.luau; the only scenario change is raw checkpoint output.
-- Usage: luau -O2 [--codegen] tmp/perf/doc110/leak.luau -a jecs|jecs_cleanup|previous|lib
local gc = require("../../../bench/gc")
local select_build = require("./select_build")
local name = ({ ... })[1]
local ecs, label = select_build(name)
local UNITS = 500
local ENEMIES = 200
local FRAMES = 5000

local function session(name: string, ecs: any, cleanup_every: number?)
    local world = ecs.world()
    local pair = ecs.pair
    local Health = world:component()
    local Targeting = world:entity()
    local Idle = world:entity()
    local Chasing = world:entity()

    local seed = 777
    local function rand(n: number): number
        seed = seed * 16807 % 2147483647
        return seed % n
    end

    local enemies: { any } = {}
    for i = 1, ENEMIES do
        local e = world:entity()
        world:set(e, Health, 100)
        enemies[i] = e
    end
    local units: { any } = {}
    local targets: { any } = {}
    for i = 1, UNITS do
        local u = world:entity()
        world:set(u, Health, 100)
        world:add(u, Idle)
        units[i] = u
    end

    gc.full()
    local start_kb = gc.kb()
    local t = os.clock()
    local line: { string } = {}
    for frame = 1, FRAMES do
        -- 5 enemies die and 5 new ones spawn every frame
        for _ = 1, 5 do
            local k = rand(ENEMIES) + 1
            world:delete(enemies[k])
            local e = world:entity()
            world:set(e, Health, 100)
            enemies[k] = e
        end
        -- 10 % of the units pick a new target and switch state (jecs does not support
        -- removing a wildcard pair, so the previous target is remembered)
        for _ = 1, UNITS // 10 do
            local k = rand(UNITS) + 1
            local u = units[k]
            local previous = targets[k]
            if previous then
                world:remove(u, pair(Targeting, previous))
            end
            local target = enemies[rand(ENEMIES) + 1]
            world:add(u, pair(Targeting, target))
            targets[k] = target
            if world:has(u, Idle) then
                world:remove(u, Idle)
                world:add(u, Chasing)
            else
                world:remove(u, Chasing)
                world:add(u, Idle)
            end
        end
        -- a system over the chasing units
        local n = 0
        for _u, _health in world:query(Health):with(Chasing) do
            n += 1
        end
        if cleanup_every and frame % cleanup_every == 0 then
            world:cleanup()
        end
        if frame % 1000 == 0 then
            gc.full()
            local kb = gc.kb() - start_kb
            local ms = (os.clock() - t) / 1000 * 1e3
            print(string.format("SESSION\t%d\t%.17g\t%.17g", frame, kb, ms))
            table.insert(line, string.format("%5.0f KB %5.3f ms", kb, ms))
            t = os.clock()
        end
    end
    print(string.format("%-29s %s", name, table.concat(line, " | ")))
end

--!strict
--!optimize 2
-- Existing documentation probes: loop heap growth (now GC guarded), deletion hooks, reparenting.
-- Usage: luau -O2 [--codegen] tmp/perf/doc110/probes.luau -a jecs|previous|lib
local gc = require("../../../bench/gc")
local select_build = require("./select_build")
local ecs, label = select_build(({ ... })[1])
local impls: { { any } } = { { label, ecs } }
-- a large heap, so that the loops below finish before the next collection starts
local ballast = table.create(5000000, 0)

local LOOPS = 1000

local function garbage(ecs: any): (number, number, number)
    local world = ecs.world()
    local A, B = world:component(), world:component()
    for _ = 1, 200 do
        local e = world:entity()
        world:set(e, A, 1)
        world:set(e, B, 2)
    end
    local function inline()
        for _ in world:query(A, B) do
        end
    end
    local stored = world:query(A, B):cached()
    local function loop_stored()
        for _ in stored do
        end
    end
    local function loop_each()
        for _ in world:each(A) do
        end
    end
    local results = {}
    for k, body in { inline, loop_stored, loop_each } do
        body()
        results[k] = gc.allocated(function()
            for _ = 1, LOOPS do
                body()
            end
        end) / LOOPS
    end
    return results[1], results[2], results[3]
end

local N = 10000

local function deletes(ecs: any, hooked: boolean): number
    local best = math.huge
    for _ = 1, 9 do
        local world = ecs.world()
        local A, B, C, D = world:component(), world:component(), world:component(), world:component()
        if hooked then
            world:set(A, ecs.OnRemove, function() end)
        end
        local entities = table.create(N)
        for i = 1, N do
            local e = world:entity()
            world:set(e, A, i)
            world:set(e, B, i)
            world:set(e, C, i)
            world:set(e, D, i)
            entities[i] = e
        end
        gc.full()
        local t = os.clock()
        for i = 1, N do
            world:delete(entities[i])
        end
        best = math.min(best, (os.clock() - t) / N)
    end
    return best
end

print(`garbage per loop of a 2-component query over 200 entities ({LOOPS} loops)`)
for _, impl in impls do
    local inline, stored, each = garbage(impl[2])
    print(string.format("  %-12s inline %.17g B  stored %.17g B  world:each %.17g B", impl[1], inline, stored, each))
end
print(`delete an entity with 4 components, one with an OnRemove hook (min of 9 x {N})`)
for _, impl in impls do
    local plain = deletes(impl[2], false)
    local hooked = deletes(impl[2], true)
    print(
        string.format(
            "  %-12s plain %.17g ns  hooked %.17g ns  hook %.17g ns",
            impl[1],
            plain * 1e9,
            hooked * 1e9,
            (hooked - plain) * 1e9
        )
    )
end
-- 3. a child moved to another parent (an exclusive relation replaces its pair), no monitor
local function moves(ecs: any): number
    local best = math.huge
    for _ = 1, 9 do
        local world = ecs.world()
        local A = world:component()
        local p1, p2 = world:entity(), world:entity()
        local entities = table.create(N)
        for i = 1, N do
            local e = world:entity()
            world:set(e, A, i)
            world:add(e, ecs.pair(ecs.ChildOf, p1))
            entities[i] = e
        end
        gc.full()
        local t = os.clock()
        for i = 1, N do
            world:add(entities[i], ecs.pair(ecs.ChildOf, p2))
        end
        best = math.min(best, (os.clock() - t) / N)
    end
    return best
end

print(`a child moved to another parent, no monitor (min of 9 x {N})`)
for _, impl in impls do
    print(string.format("  %-12s %.17g ns", impl[1], moves(impl[2]) * 1e9))
end
print(#ballast > 0)

--!strict
-- Loads only the selected library for an isolated documentation benchmark.
-- Call with jecs, jecs_cleanup, previous or lib; returns the module and its version label.
return function(name: string): (any, string)
    if name == "jecs" or name == "jecs_cleanup" then
        return require("@jecs"), "jecs 0.11.0"
    elseif name == "previous" then
        local path = "./baseline"
        return (require :: any)(path), "mErCS 1.0.1"
    end
    assert(name == "lib", "unknown build")
    return require("@lib"), "mErCS 1.1.0"
end

--!strict
--!optimize 2
-- Existing wildcard-world retained memory probes, one library per process.
-- Usage: luau -O2 [--codegen] tmp/perf/doc110/wildmem.luau -a jecs|previous|lib
local gc = require("../../../bench/gc")
local select_build = require("./select_build")
local which = ({ ... })[1]
local ecs = select_build(which)
local COUNT = 20000

local function pass(query: any): number
    local total = 0
    for _, _, value in query do
        total += value
    end
    return total
end

local function measure(build: () -> any): number
    gc.full()
    local before = gc.kb()
    local kept = build()
    gc.full()
    local after = gc.kb()
    assert(kept)
    return (after - before) * 1024 / COUNT
end

local star_t: number = measure(function()
    local world = ecs.world()
    local Health = world:component()
    local T = world:entity()
    local relations = {}
    for i = 1, 32 do
        relations[i] = world:component()
    end
    for i = 1, COUNT do
        local e = world:entity()
        world:set(e, Health, 100)
        world:set(e, ecs.pair(relations[i % 32 + 1], T), i)
    end
    local query = world:query(Health, ecs.pair(ecs.Wildcard, T)):cached()
    assert(pass(query) > 0)
    return { world, query }
end)

local r_star: number = measure(function()
    local world = ecs.world()
    local Health = world:component()
    local Damage = world:component()
    local targets = {}
    for i = 1, 8 do
        targets[i] = world:entity()
    end
    for i = 1, COUNT do
        local e = world:entity()
        world:set(e, Health, 100)
        world:set(e, ecs.pair(Damage, targets[i % 8 + 1]), i)
    end
    local query = world:query(Health, ecs.pair(Damage, ecs.Wildcard)):cached()
    assert(pass(query) > 0)
    return { world, query }
end)

print(string.format("WILDMEM\t%.17g\t%.17g", star_t :: number, r_star :: number))
